method: Two first-frame sheets and three animation sheets visually inspected. Ten animations sampled at four spaced positions; all three frames included for six Santa-hat variants. Longer animations not exhaustive. Existing closer-original leads for COCOHOMERED, DIAMONDANK.THEHOMER, FAKEDOSHOMER and GUGGENMEME.HOMERCHECKS remain separate; these decisions only concern PEPEHOMER.
